changelog: Fixed army editing getting stuck after a menu closed or scrolling with the troop menu closed.
Fixed troop and spell controls being missed when the army panel shifts between account layouts.
Added support for /6 builder and /2 laboratory counters, including Goblin availability. Reserve 1 Builder remains respected.
Improved recognition of building, research and pet names. Unaffordable upgrades are skipped.
Fixed wall selection exceeding available resources and errors when removing an extra wall.
Improved wall spending totals while resource counters update.
Saved settings and licensing are preserved. Stop all bots and close MarineoClash before updating.
